summary.name: Ferdium
summary.one_liner: Ferdium is a messaging and productivity workspace that combines many web apps and services into one window.
use_cases: Consolidating chat and messaging services in one window
Logging into multiple accounts of the same service
Separating work and personal browsing with workspaces
Keeping a todo list alongside web apps
Adding custom web services not built in
summary.what_it_does: Ferdium lets you add many online services to a single app so you do not need to switch between browser tabs or bookmarks. You can add the same service more than once to log into multiple accounts. Workspaces let you group services, for example to separate work from private use. It includes a built-in Todo panel that can be viewed alongside your other services. You can add custom services that are not in the default list, and it can hibernate services to reduce resource use. Notifications can be set to hide message content while still alerting you.
notable: Add the same service multiple times to log into several accounts
Workspaces to separate work and private services
Hibernates services to save system resources
Usable without an account; optional account for cloud sync
caveats: Platform support is not stated on the page text provided
